externalMethodAuthority.primary: Mercik, Zaremba & Demir (2026), Crypto Factor Zoo, International Review of Financial Analysis 113, 105137
externalMethodAuthority.turnoverDefinition: last day's dollar trading volume divided by market value
externalMethodAuthority.turnoverVolatilityDefinition: standard deviation of daily turnover over a trailing 30-day estimation period; algebraically equivalent to residual standard deviation from daily-turnover-on-constant regression
externalMethodAuthority.direction: -1: long low characteristic values and short high characteristic values
externalMethodAuthority.sourceCostSensitivity: paper evaluates 0.1%, 0.2%, 0.3%, 0.4% trading-cost levels and reports turnover-volatility remains economically meaningful under moderate costs

adaptationDisclosure.reason: Source uses a broad active+inactive spot universe and exchange-aggregated data. MarketsGPT requires a directly tradable Binance perpetual implementation.
adaptationDisclosure.signalData: historical daily market cap and 24h USD volume from a point-in-time crypto market-data provider; both fields must come from the same provider per asset/day
adaptationDisclosure.universe: fixed 120-symbol current-survivor tradable set used in independent prior causally-distinct branches
adaptationDisclosure.promotionLimit: Even a holdout pass is evidence only for this survivor-conditioned tradable-perpetual adaptation, not the original 565-coin spot factor.

dataAuthority.historicalMarketDataRequirement: daily price-independent market_cap and total_volume/24h_volume covering at least 2024-07-01 through 2026-09-14
dataAuthority.binanceExecution: official Binance USD-M 1d klines / public archive
dataAuthority.unlockCondition: Connect a provider exposing historical per-asset market cap and daily USD volume, then record provider/version/field semantics and transport parity before any return outcome is calculated.

signalContract.dailyTurnover: historical USD volume / historical market cap
signalContract.estimator: sample standard deviation, ddof=1, of the 30 strictly completed daily turnover observations
signalContract.decision: Monday 00:00 UTC; use daily data ending no later than Sunday 00:00/last fully completed provider daily snapshot before decision
signalContract.longBook: lowest quartile of eligible assets, equal weighted, total +0.50
signalContract.execution: Monday Binance perpetual open to next Monday open

costs.chargedOn: sum absolute portfolio-weight changes plus terminal liquidation

statistics.multipleTestingNote: Given the project's large prior hypothesis count, all predeclared uncertainty gates are binding; point estimates never override failed gates.

failureRule: No outcome may open until the historical market-cap/volume provider is frozen. Any development failure closes TVOL1 without threshold, cost, cadence, universe, weighting or direction rescue. Validation/holdout remain sealed after any failed prior gate.
